rules: Personal Best, Final Score Mark and Finish Claim remain three separate Solo result identities.
The Personal Best glyph is shown only for a real new Solo high score.
The Finish Claim glyph does not change claimReward(false), reward persistence or duplicate-claim protection.
The locked Solo Rewarded Video composition remains owned by the Rewarded Video family.
The main Solo menu and intro identity is not a Solo result glyph.
Preserve display sizes, result motion ordering and reduced-motion behavior during integration.
Use the canonical runtime pack instead of copying or recoloring individual Solo result glyphs.
